title: Maximum of an accumulation function
statement:
Where does $F(x)=\int_0^x([$a]^2-t^2)\,dt$ attain its maximum on $[0,[$a]+2]$? Give the input.

[__________]{a}
hints: Find the positive zero of the integrand.
Classify it by the sign change.
solution: $F'(x)=[$a]^2-x^2$ is positive below $[$a]$ and negative above it. The maximum is at $x=[$a]$.

feedback.message: Classify it by the sign change.
